FrontMatterCondition.description: A front matter key, and optionally a pattern its value must match. Without `matches` the key only has to exist.

matches.description: Pattern for the value; absent means the key only has to exist.

Matcher.description: One condition on a text unit: a PCRE2 pattern, or a list of words and phrases. Matching is case-insensitive unless `case_sensitive` is true.

case_sensitive.description: Match case. Matching ignores case when false.

pattern.description: PCRE2 pattern. Exactly one of `pattern` and `words` is set.

words.description: Words and phrases, matched as whole words.

When.description: Structural conditions. All given conditions must hold. `path` and `front_matter` are document conditions; `heading_path`, `admonition_title` and `block_kind` are block conditions; `sentence` is a sentence condition. Patterns are PCRE2 and case-insensitive. Blocks of kind `code-block` are skipped unless `block_kind` names them.

admonition_title.description: Matches the title of the enclosing admonition.

front_matter.description: Front matter key and a pattern for its value.

heading_path.description: Matches when the text of any enclosing heading matches.

path.description: Matches the file path, with forward slashes.

sentence.description: Matches the text of a sentence.

description: A context tagger written as data. It marks text units with a context tag that rules can gate on (rule contexts only and skip). It runs without code and is deterministic. A tag carries a span, a confidence and evidence, like the tags a code tagger returns over the plugin protocol. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/plugins.md. A tagger has either `match` entries, which read the text of one unit, or a `when` object, which reads document structure.

description.description: What the tagger does, for people.

evidence.description: Short text that explains the tag in reports.

match.description: The tagger fires when at least one entry matches the unit. Not with `when`.

scope.description: How far a matching condition spreads its tag: `sentence` tags each matching sentence, `paragraph` the matching block, `section` the enclosing heading section (up to the next heading of the same or a shallower level) and `document` the whole document.

tag.description: The context tag the tagger sets.

unit.description: The text unit that receives the tag. The span of a tag is the whole unit.

unless.description: The tagger stays silent for a unit where any of these entries matches. Not with `when`.

title: slopvac v3 declarative tagger
